name: Beyhadh
description: Maya falls in love with Arjun while working on an assignment. But soon, her love for him turns into an obsession, affecting their relationship with each other and their respective family members.

videos.title: Arjun and Saanjh Ki Dosti
videos.overview: Beyhadh is a romantic thriller showcasing lives of Maya, Arjun and Saanjh. Arjun and Saanjh are dancing in front of Ganesha idol, while Maya enters the venue and bows down before the deity. Saanjh's parents advise her to marry Arjun. However, Saanjh clears it to them that Arjun is not her boyfriend. Next morning, Saanjh wakes Arjun up from sleep and reminds him of his job interview.

videos.title: Arjun Bags A New Job
videos.overview: Arjun enters Maya’s office for a job interview. He impresses Maya with his confidence and charm. On the other hand, Saanjh tells her family that she is eagerly waiting to meet Arjun. Maya offers Arjun a job in her company. Later, Arjun’s family congratulate him for getting a new job.

videos.title: Maya Fires Arjun From His Job
videos.overview: Arjun reaches his office and meets Maya. Arjun informs Saanjh that he has reached a studio for a photoshoot. Maya orders Arjun to look after the male models. Saanjh reaches the venue to meet Arjun. Dev introduces himself to Saanjh. Arjun beats Dev for troubling Saanjh. Maya fires Arjun from his job.

videos.title: Arjun Ki Chalaki
videos.overview: Arjun tells Saanjh that she need not apologize to Maya. Saanjh’s parents advise her to marry Arjun at the earliest. Saanjh reminds her family that she doesn’t wish to marry Arjun. Next day, Arjun comes to Maya’s office. Will Arjun be able to retain his job?

videos.title: Arjun Ka Presentation
videos.overview: Maya asks Arjun to give a presentation within two hours. Arjun seeks helps from his colleagues to prepare the presentation. However, they refuse to help Arjun. Saanjh comes to Maya’s office to meet her friend Arjun. After a while, Arjun enters the conference room to give his presentation.

videos.title: Maya Terminates Arjun From Work
videos.overview: Arjun impresses a client of Maya’s company with his presentation. Saanjh’s boss tells her that they have to meet Maya to discuss about her legal case. Saanjh tells Arjun that she is afraid to meet his boss. Saanjh and colleagues meet Maya in a restaurant. Maya hands Arjun over his termination letter.

videos.title: Arjun Steals Maya's Film Passes
videos.overview: Maya tells Arjun that he should not have consumed alcohol in her company. She asks Arjun to prepare the client presentation by midnight. Maya's assistant informs Arjun that her boss has received two film passes. Arjun and Saanjh plan to go to the theatre to watch movie. Arjun steals Maya's film passes.

videos.title: Maya Punishes Arjun
videos.overview: Arjun brings his friends to a theatre to watch movie. Arjun gets shocked to see Maya and her mother entering into the theatre. Saanjh tells Arjun that he should not have stolen Maya’s film passes. Later, Maya decides to lodge a police complaint against Arjun for stealing her film passes.

videos.title: Arjun Traps Maya in Elevator
videos.overview: Arjun decides to teach Maya a lesson for locking him inside a restroom. Arjun cuts out the main electricity when Maya is inside an elevator of her office. After a while, Arjun opens the door of the elevator and asks Maya to come out of it. When Maya finally comes out of the elevator she collapses in Arjun’s arms.

videos.title: Arjun Plans To Celebrate Maya's Birthday
videos.overview: Saanjh asks Arjun to apologize to Maya for his past mistakes. She also informs Arjun that she is going to visit Maya’s office in the evening. Arjun enters Maya’s cabin but does not apologize to her. Later, Arjun tells Saanjh that they must go to Maya’s house at midnight to celebrate her birthday.

videos.title: Maya Ka Birthday
videos.overview: Arjun and Saanjh decide to celebrate Maya's birthday. They bring a cake and enter Maya's apartment. A security guard stops them from meeting Maya. Maya's father intrude into her house. Maya locks herself in a room. Arjun and Saanjh return home. Arjun's mother thanks him and Saanjh for remembering her birthday.

videos.title: Arjun Celebrates Maya's Birthday
videos.overview: Arjun celebrates his mother's birthday along with his family. Next morning, Maya and her mother go to a temple. Maya's father enters the temple and stands behind her. Two stray dogs attack Maya's father. Arjun informs Saanjh that he is going to celebrate Maya's birthday in the office.

videos.title: Arjun Smears Cake On Maya's Face
videos.overview: Arjun and his colleagues celebrate Maya's birthday. Arjun applies cake on Maya's face. Maya suddenly walks out of her office. Saanjh advises Arjun to apologize to Maya. Maya comes home and locks herself in a room. Maya's mother requests her to open the door.

videos.title: Rashmi Finds Alliance for Saanjh
videos.overview: Rashmi tells Saanjh's parents that she has found an alliance for their daughter. Maya's father comes to her house. His wife clears it to him that she would not allow him to meet Maya. Maya's father demands cash from his wife.

videos.title: Arjun Climbes Maya's Apartment
videos.overview: Arjun climbs into Maya's apartment. Maya's mother gets shocked to see Arjun in Maya's room. Arjun tells Maya that he requires her signatures on office documents. Maya challenges Arjun to climb down from her multi-floored apartment. On the other hand, Saanjh's mother advise her to share her feelings to Arjun.

videos.title: Maya Hides Arjun's Secret
videos.overview: Saanjh tells her brother that Arjun may not agree to marry her. Arjun comes to Maya's office. Maya's colleagues blame Arjun for stealing confidential information from Maya's computer. He also asks Arjun as to where he was on the earlier night. Arjun refuses to answer and moves out of the office.

videos.title: Arjun Catches The Thief
videos.overview: Arjun decides to check the CCTV footage of Maya's cabin. Arjun and Maya enter the cabin and switch on the laptop. Later, Arjun calls Saanjh and informs her that he is stuck in the office along with Maya. Next morning, Arjun and Maya decide to catch the person who had stolen confidential information from company's database.

videos.title: Ashwin Gives A Gifts To Maya's Mother
videos.overview: Maya offers salary hike to Arjun. Later, Arjun's mother saves him from falling off the building roof. On the other hand, Ashwin comes to Maya's house. Maya's mother requests him to not cause any trouble to Maya. Ashwin gives a gift to Maya's mother.

videos.title: Maya Slits Her Wrist
videos.overview: Maya's mother tells her that her husband Ashwin still loves her a lot. Maya burns the saree gifted by Ashwin. She asks her mother to not befriend Ashwin. Saanjh's brother advises her to reveal her feelings to Arjun. Maya notices her mother and Arjun chatting with each other. Later, Maya takes her mother in the car. Maya's mother spots Maya's bleeding wrist.

videos.title: Saanjh Meets Jitendra
videos.overview: Maya's mother request her to look after her health. Saanjh tells Arjun that she is going to meet Jitendra Kumar in a restaurant. Ashwin comes to Maya's house. He demands five lakh rupees from Maya's mother. However, she refuses to give him the money. Jitendra kumar meets Saanjh and Arjun in the restaurant.

videos.title: Arjun Saves Maya From Ashwin's Humiliation
videos.overview: Ashwin approaches Maya and demands money from her. Maya requests Ashwin to not cause her any trouble. Arjun stops Ashwin from slapping Maya. He angrily asks Ashwin to stay away from Maya. Maya hurriedly moves out of the restaurant. Next day, Maya allows her staff to leave early from the office.

videos.title: Jitendra Refuses To Marry Saanjh
videos.overview: Jitendra advises Saanjh to reveal her feeling to Arjun. When Maya gets into her car, Arjun follows her and requests for a lift. Arjun, along with a few school children, enters Maya's car. After a while, the car stops due to traffic jam. Arjun and his small friends get out of the car and play in the rain.

videos.title: Maya Returns Arjun's Wallet
videos.overview: Arjun tells Saanjh that a goon might have attacked Ayan. Arjun and Saanjh meet Ayan in an old building. Ayan tells them that a girl has looted him. Maya angrily asks her mother as to why she met Arjun. Maya’s mother advises her to befriend Arjun. Maya calls Arjun to her cabin and returns him his wallet.

videos.title: Maya Meets Saanjh's Family
videos.overview: Arjun gives instructions to a model while doing photoshoot for his company. Saanjh congratulates Suman on the occasion of her wedding anniversary. Arjun tells Maya that he is going to meet Saanjh. Later, Arjun introduces Maya to Saanjh’s family. Maya decides to participate in the wedding anniversary celebration.

videos.title: Saanjh Prepares To Propose Arjun
videos.overview: Saanjh and her family celebrate her parents’ wedding anniversary. Later, Saanjh’s parents advise her to propose to Arjun for marriage. Maya calls Arjun and asks him to come to her office at the earliest. While giving presentation, Arjun tells his colleagues that he wishes to use Maya as a model for their company’s campaign.

videos.title: Arjun Impresses Maya With His Presentation
videos.overview: Arjun shows his presentation to Maya and his colleagues. Arjun calls Saanjh and informs her that his boss has liked his presentation. Maya gives a tuxedo to Arjun. Later, she brings Arjun to a fashion event. Maya and Arjun walk in front of media, holding each other’s hands.

videos.title: Maya And Arjun Attend The Fashion Event
videos.overview: Arjun calls Saanjh and asks her as to why she did not attend the fashion event. Saanjh replies Arjun that the security guard did not allow her to enter the hall. Saanjh requests Arjun to meet her after the event. Next morning, Arjun meets Saanjh on the terrace of her apartment.

videos.title: Ashwin Meets Maya In The Shopping Mall
videos.overview: Arjun gifts a photo-frame to Maya. Prem advises Saanjh to propose Arjun for marriage. Saanjh promises Prem that she would propose Arjun on the same day. Arjun and Saanjh plan to go for shopping. Maya buys a watch in the shopping mall. Ashwin enters the mall and stands before Maya.

videos.title: Arjun Introduces Jhanvi To Saanjh
videos.overview: Arjun meets Maya and her mother. He introduces them to Saanjh. Maya’s mother advises her to befriend Arjun. On the other hand, Vandana thanks Arjun for gifting her a saree. Jahnavi meets Ashwin and asks him to stay away from her daughter. She furthers tells Ashwin that she may soon reveal his secret to Maya.

videos.title: Maya Refuses To Meet Saanjh
videos.overview: Prem tells Suman that Arjun should not have gone into Saanjh's room at the night. He reminds Suman that Saanjh has fallen for Arjun. Next morning, one of Maya's clients meets Arjun and praises him for his photography skills. Saanjh comes to Maya's office. However, Maya refuses to meet Saanjh.

videos.title: Arjun Yells At Maya
videos.overview: Maya calls Saanjh to her cabin. Saanjh tells Maya that she was waiting for her for last five hours. She further informs Maya that she is a very close friend of Arjun. Maya refuses to accept Saanjh's presentation. Saanjh returns home and meets Arjun. Later, Arjun angrily asks Maya to not cause any harm to Saanjh.

videos.title: Saanjh Comes to Maya's House
videos.overview: Arjun enters into Maya's room and yells at her for insulting Saanjh. He clears it to Maya that Saanjh is his best friends. He instructs Maya to not hurt Saanjh in the future. Later, Arjun returns home and meets Saanjh. Saanjh thanks Arjun for standing by her. Next day, Saanjh comes to Maya's house.

videos.title: Maya Gives A Gift Box To Saanjh
videos.overview: Saanj comes to Maya's house. Maya serves food to Saanjh. Arjun's mother tells him that he should not have allowed Saanjh to visit Maya's house. Ashwin meets Jhanvi tells her that he loves her a lot. Saanj tells Maya that she wishes to go back to her house.

videos.title: Saanjh Hands Over Maya's Gift To Arjun
videos.overview: Saanjh meets Arjun and tells him that Maya has given him a gift. She further tells Arjun that Maya has fallen for him. Next morning, Saanjh tells Vandana that Maya had gifted a watch to Arjun. Vandana tells Saanjh that she should marry Arjun. On the other hand, Arjun reaches the office and meets Maya.

videos.title: Arjun Drops Maya To Her House
videos.overview: Arjun tells Maya that no one can break his friendship with Saanjh. Ashwin tells Shipra that he had forced Jhanvi to eat sweets. Suman tells Vandana that she will not allow Maya to interfere in Arjun's personal life. Arjun drops Maya to her house. Maya notices her mother lying unconscious in her room. Saanjh's mother welcomes her and Arjun to her house.

videos.title: Arjun Rushes To Help Maya
videos.overview: Arjun rushes to Maya's house. He learns that Maya's mother has fallen unconscious. He brings Maya's mother to a hospital. On the other hand, Prem tells Saanjh that Arjun doesn't love her. He advises Saanjh to forget Arjun and move on with her life. Saanjh tells her parents that she is going to the hospital to help Arjun.

videos.title: Maya's Father Threatens Her In The Hospital
videos.overview: A doctor informs Maya that Jhanvi's health is stable. Ashwin comes to the hospital and meets Maya. He tells Maya that he has bought a cadbury for Jhanvi. Suman scolds Prem for misbehaving with Vandana. Maya asks Arjun to stay along with her in the hospital for a night.

videos.title: Maya Comes To Arjun's House
videos.overview: Maya requests Arjun to accompany her in the hospital. Arjun falls asleep on the sofa. Saanjh makes a call to Arjun but fails to reach him. Maya breaks Arjun's phone into pieces. Next morning, the doctor checks Jhanvi's health and tells Maya that her mother is now stable. Maya comes to Arjun's house to meet him.

videos.title: Maya Gifts A Mobile To Arjun
videos.overview: Maya comes to Arjun’s house. She gifts a new mobile phone to Arjun. Later, Arjun’s family invites Maya for the breakfast. Saanjh enters the room and meets Maya. Arjun’s mother tells Maya that she treats Saanjh as her family member. Later, Maya calls Arjun to her office.

videos.title: Arjun And Saanjh Go To Lonavala
videos.overview: Saanjh calls Arjun and tells him that she is planning to go to Daman for picnic. Arjun replies Saanjh that they should rather plan their picnic to Lonavala. Ashwin's girlfriend asks him to bring money from Jhanvi. Saanjh's mother asks her to reveal her feelings to Arjun once she reaches Lonavala.

videos.title: Maya Proposes Arjun
videos.overview: Maya asks Arjun to meet her at 'tiger point'. Arjun tells Saanjh that soon he is going to give her a surprise. Arjun reaches 'tiger point' to meet Maya. He notices a hot air balloon on the surface. Maya blindfolds Arjun and handcuffs him inside the basket of the balloon. She holds a ring before Arjun. She tells Arjun that she loves him.

videos.title: Arjun And Saanjh Fight Over Maya
videos.overview: Arjun clears it to Saanjh that he doesn't love Maya. Saanjh asks Arjun to stop working for Maya. Maya returns home and meets her mother. She tells Jhanvi that she loves Arjun a lot. On the other hand, Arjun tells Saanjh that he will not resign from his job.

videos.title: Maya Gives Promotion to Arjun
videos.overview: Maya tells Arjun that she has promoted him as senior photographer in her company. Saanjh comes to Maya's office and meets Arjun. Maya tells Arjun that she has invited Saanjh to celebrate his promotion. Later, Saanjh tells Arjun that Maya has promoted him not because of his talent but because she loves him.

videos.title: Arjun Brings Maya To Roadside Tea Stall
videos.overview: Saanjh tells Arjun that Maya has promoted him because she has fallen for him. Arjun yells at Saanjh and asks her to not be jealous of him. Saanjh angrily walks out from the office. On the other hand, Vandana and Suman meets a pandit. Arjun brings Maya to a roadside tea stall. He offers tea to Maya.

videos.title: Arjun Brings Ice Cream
videos.overview: Saanjh tells Suman that Arjun has gone to meet Maya. Suman advises Saanjh to wait until Arjun realizes her love and comes back into her life. Maya invites Arjun in her house and offers him ice-cream. Next morning, Arjun meets Saanjh and assures her that he would have lunch along with her in the afternoon.

videos.title: Maya Gives Expensive Gifts
videos.overview: Arjun tells Maya that he is going out for lunch. Arjun's colleagues request him to participate in the office party. Arjun informs Saanjh that he can not join her for the lunch. Vandana makes a call to Saanjh. She asks Saanjh to come home. Saanjh reminds Arjun that Maya is trying to impress him by giving him expensive gifts.

videos.title: Police Arrests Arjun's Brother
videos.overview: Saanjh tells Arjun that Maya is trying to impress him by offering expensive gifts. Jhanvi tells Maya that she should not have given gifts to Arjun. Arjun comes to Maya's house. He returns the gifts to Maya and clears it to her that she can not influence him by money. Police arrests Ayan for his alleged involvement in drug trade. Arjun comes to police station and request the police to release Ayan from jail.

videos.title: Maya Bails Arjun's Brother Out
videos.overview: A policeman asks Arjun to bail Ayan out of jail. He ends up slapping Arjun for his misconduct. Maya enters the police station. She brings a lawyer to release Ayan out from jail. Maya learns that the policeman has misbehaved with Arjun. She slaps the policeman for his mistake. Maya assures Ayan that she would help him in times of need.

videos.title: Arjun Brings Maya To The Terrace
videos.overview: Maya drops Arjun to his house in her car. She requests Arjun to take her to the terrace of his building. Arjun makes a call to his brother. He requests Ayan to not allow Saanjh to meet Maya. Arjun brings Maya to the terrace. Arjun assures Maya that he would treat her as a friend and not the boss.

videos.title: Arjun And Maya's Photograph
videos.overview: Saanjh notices Maya and Arjun on the terrace of the building. Saanjh breaks down in tears in front of her father. Prem comforts Saanjh and requests her to calm down. Maya hugs Arjun close to her. Ashwin secretly captures Maya and Arjun's photograph in his mobile phone. Next morning, Arjun and Maya learn that their photograph has been published in a newspaper.

videos.title: Maya Ka Ateet
videos.overview: Arjun clears it to Saanjh that he does not love Maya. Ashwin learns that Arjun and Saanjh are close friends. Arjun makes a call to Maya. He asks Maya as to why she lied to him about her past. Ashwin meets Jhanvi and tells her that he is going to reveal Maya's secret to Arjun.

videos.title: Arjun Infuses Maya's Life With Color
videos.overview: Maya reaches her office rushes to the basement. Arjun shouts at Maya for keeping her secret from him. Arjun tells Maya that they should renovate the basement of her office. He further advises Maya to forget the bitter past incidences of her life. Later, Arjun also tells Maya that she should infuse her life with new colors.

videos.title: Arjun Gifts A Dress To Maya
videos.overview: Ayan makes a call to Saanjh. He tells her that Arjun has brought a gift for her. Arjun gifts a new red-colored dress to Maya. He advises Maya to not stuck in the past and to move on with life. Later, Saanjh meets Arjun and asks him to gift her the dress. Arjun informs Ayan that the gift was meant for Maya and not Saanjh.

videos.title: Vandana Ka Ateet
videos.overview: Arjun tells Ayan that he had given the gift to Maya. Vandana enquires Saanjh about the dress given by Arjun. Saanjh informs Vandana that the gift was meant for Maya. Vandana yells at Arjun for breaking Saanjh's heart. Arjun shouts back at his stepmother and asks her to not interfere in his personal life. Later, Vandana informs Saanjh that Arjun's mother died due to cancer.

videos.title: Maya Reveals Her Past To Arjun
videos.overview: Maya tells Arjun that her father Ashwin used to torture her when she was a child. She informs Arjun that her childhood memories still haunt her. Arjun returns home and meets Vandana. Vandana informs Arjun that she has decided to move out of the house. Arjun apologizes to Vandana for his past mistakes. He requests Vandana to not leave the house.

videos.title: Arjun Brings Maya To His House
videos.overview: Saanjh's parents spot Arjun and Maya together on a terrace. Saanjh informs her parents that Arjun has apologized to his mother for his past mistakes. Later, Suman tells Prem that they should reveal Arjun's truth to Saanjh. Arjun brings Maya to his house. Later, Saanjh tells Vandana that Arjun doesn't love her anymore.

videos.title: Arjun Beats Ashwin
videos.overview: Ashwin comes to Arjun’s house. He meets Vandana and tells her that Maya and Arjun have fallen for each other. Arjun drags Ashwin out of his house and starts beating him. Saanjh requests Arjun to not interfere in Maya’s personal life. Later, Maya asks Arjun to get ready to go to Mauritius the next day. Vandana and Ayan informs Saanjh that Arjun is going to Mauritius.

videos.title: Saanjh Spots Arjun And Maya
videos.overview: Maya meets Arjun at the at the airport. She tells Arjun that she too would come to Mauritius along with him. Saanjh spots Arjun and Maya together at the airport. She returns home and meets her parents. She tells Vandana that Arjun might have started liking Maya. Arjun and Maya board the aeroplane.

videos.title: Arjun And Maya Reach Mauritius
videos.overview: Arjun and Maya reach Mauritius. Maya hires a luxurious car and brings Arjun near a beach. Arjun makes a call to Saanjh. However, Saanjh refuses to answer the call. Arjun and his crew go to an islet. Arjun starts taking photographs of the beautiful surroundings. Arjun's colleagues tells him that that they must return to the mainland. However, Arjun prefers to stay on the islet.

videos.title: Maya Rescues Arjun
videos.overview: Maya learns that Arjun is trapped on an islet. Maya rides a speedboat and heads towards the sea in search of Arjun. Prem asks Saanjh to go to Mauritius. He advises Saanjh to reveal her feelings to Arjun. Maya rescues Arjun from the islet. She scolds Arjun for being careless.

videos.title: Arjun Proposes Maya
videos.overview: Saanjh comes to Mauritius to meet Arjun. She reaches the hotel and assumes that Arjun has planned a surprise for her. She sits in a boat and rows it out into the sea. Maya wears an oxygen mask and gets into the water. Arjun gives a ring to Maya. Saanjh gets shocked to see Arjun and Maya together into the water.

videos.title: Saanjh Gets The Shock Of Her Life
videos.overview: Saanjh gets the shock of her life when she spots Arjun and Maya exchanging rings with each other. Later, Maya and Arjun visit a temple. A pujari advises Arjun to not stay along with Maya. He tells Arjun that he may lose his family if he marries Maya.

videos.title: Saanjh Meets Arjun In Mauritius
videos.overview: Saanjh meets Arjun and Maya in the resort. Arjun thanks Saanjh for coming all the way to Mauritius. Saanjh notices that one of Maya's earrings is missing. Next day, Saanjh visits a temple. She finds Maya's earring in front of the temple. Saanjh tells Arjun that the pujari has passed away.

videos.title: Arjun Brings Maya
videos.overview: Arjun, Maya and Saanjh board a plane to India. Saanjh returns home and meets her parents. She informs them that Arjun doesn’t love her. On the other hand, Arjun requests Maya to meet his mother. Later, he brings Maya to his house. Vandana gets shocked to see Maya along with Arjun.

videos.title: Arjun Stops Ashwin
videos.overview: Vandana comes to Saanjh's house. She comforts Saanjh and requests her to calm down. Maya brings Arjun to her house. Jhanvi informs Maya that she has decided to stay along with Ashwin. Ashwin brings a cake for his family. Maya smashes the cake on Ashwin's face. Arjun asks Ashwin to get out from the house.

videos.title: Maya Stops Jhanvi
videos.overview: Maya angrily asks Ashwin to get out from her house. Prem asks Vandana to not interfere in Saanjh's life. Vandana clears it to Prem that she will not end her relationship with Saanjh come what may. Maya stops her mother from moving out of her house. Arjun returns home and meets his mother.

videos.title: Ashwin Throws Jhanvi Off A Bridge
videos.overview: Jhanvi and Ashwin come to a bridge over a river. Ashwin throws Jhanvi off the bridge. Maya jumps in the water to save her mother. As soon as Arjun reaches the scene, Ashwin informs him that Maya has fallen off the bridge. Ashwin rescues Maya and Jhanvi from the water. Arjun and Ashwin admit Maya to a hospital.

videos.title: Saanjh Decides To Walk Away
videos.overview: A doctor tells Arjun that Maya is out of danger and her health is stable. Ashwin secretly enters Maya's hospital room. He tries to suffocate Maya with a pillow. Maya shouts at Ashwin and calls Arjun to her room. Saanjh returns home and meets her parents. She tells them that she must walk away from Arjun's life.

videos.title: Saanjh Moves Out Of Her House
videos.overview: Arjun informs Maya that Ashwin has saved her life. Saanjh's brother requests her to not go to abroad. Maya wakes up and finds Arjun sleeping beside her. The doctor tells Arjun that he has decided to discharge Maya from the hospital. Vandana requests Saanjh to not walk away from Arjun's life.

videos.title: Arjun Stops Saanjh
videos.overview: Arjun learns that Saanjh is going to Singapore. He rushes towards the airport to meet Saanjh. A doctor tells Maya that he has decided to discharge her from the hospital. On the other hand, Prem requests Arjun to not interfere in Saanjh's life. Saanjh tells Arjun that she loves him a lot.

videos.title: Maya Invites Saanjh For A Party
videos.overview: Arjun tells Maya that Saanjh loves him a lot. Maya replies Arjun that she is already aware about Saanjh's infatuation towards him. Prem tells Saanjh that she should not have returned home. Maya invites Vandana and Saanjh to her house for a party. Maya informs the media that she was abused by her father in her childhood.

videos.title: Arjun Proposes Maya For Marriage
videos.overview: The media ask Ashwin as to why he abused his family in the past. Maya clears it to the media that she has decided to forgive Ashwin for his past mistakes. Later, Maya tells Arjun that her father may ill-treat her in the future. Arjun proposes Maya for marriage in front of media.

videos.title: Saanjh's Boss Fires Her
videos.overview: Maya tells Ashwin that he would not be able to torture her in the future. On the other hand, Saanjh tells her parents that she is going to forget her bitter past and move forward in her life. Saanjh's learns that her boss has fired her from his law firm.

videos.title: Saanjh Accepts Maya's Job Offer
videos.overview: Saanjh receives an email from an unknown person who advises her to accept the job offered by Maya. Vandana comes to Jhanvi's house. She tells Jhanvi that she wishes to match Arjun and Maya's natal charts. Maya tells Arjun that her parents must not share their natal charts with the astrologer.

videos.title: Maya Asks Arjun For A Secret Promise
videos.overview: Astrologer tells Vandana that Arjun and Maya's natal charts are matching well. He further tells Arjun and Maya that they can marry each other. Later, Arjun informs Maya that he had bribed the astrologer to foretell a match in their charts. Ashwin prepares lunch and serves it to his family. Maya forces Ashwin to taste the food prepared by him. Maya asks Arjun for a promise that he would not let anyone else enter in their relationship.

videos.title: Maya's Mother Claims Shares
videos.overview: Maya meets Arjun and tells him that Jhanvi has gone missing from the house. Later, Maya and Arjun find Jhanvi in the office. Jhanvi claims her shares in Maya's company. Maya tells her parents that she has decided to resign from her post. Maya informs her staff that she has promoted Arjun as the Managing Director of the company. Saanjh finds out that Maya's medical insurance was rejected several times by the insurer.

videos.title: Saanjh Finds Out Maya's Secret
videos.overview: Sanchi gets a mail from an anonymous person asking her to stop Maya and Arjun's proposed wedding. Saanjh finds out that Maya is suffering from depression and mental illness. She decides to inform the truth to Arjun. Later, Maya clears it to Arjun that she is determined to marry him.

videos.title: Saanjh Reveals Maya's Secret
videos.overview: Saanjh plans to find out Maya's background. She learns that Maya had tried to commit suicide in the past. Saanjh meets Arjun and tells him that Maya is suffering from depression. She also informs Arjun that Maya was once suspended from her school. Jhanvi tells Arjun that she herself is suffering from mental illness.

videos.title: Saanjh Refuses To Attend Arjun's Wedding
videos.overview: Jhanvi tells Saanjh that her daughter Maya is not suffering from depression. Vandana comes to Prem's house. She invites Prem and his family to Arjun's wedding. Arjun scolds Saanjh for giving mental stress to Maya. Saanjh clears it to her parents that she will not attend Arjun's 'haldi' ceremony. Maya slap Ashwin for misbehaving with her.

videos.title: Maya Slaps Ashwin
videos.overview: Maya slaps Ashwin for misbehaving with her. She instructs Ashwin to not interfere in her personal life. Maya meets Jhanvi and tells her that Ashwin would not trouble her in the future. Jhanvi replies Maya that Ashwin may reveal her past to Arjun. Saanjh tells her mother that she does not wish to attend Arjun's wedding.

videos.title: Jhanvi Cancels Maya's Haldi Ceremony
videos.overview: Vandana and her relatives gather for Arjun's 'haldi' ceremony. Ashwin comes to Maya's house. Maya stops Ashwin from applying turmeric on her face. Maya locks herself in her room. Jhanvi cancels the 'haldi' ceremony. Ashwin tells Jhanvi that he wants his shares in Maya's company. Arjun comes to Jhanvi's house to meet Maya. He comforts Maya and requests her to calm down.

videos.title: Ashwin Plans To Stop Maya's Wedding
videos.overview: Ashwin meets Saanjh and tells her that Arjun should not marry Maya. He further tells Saanjh that he can help her reunite with Arjun. Saanjh angrily asks Ashwin to not interfere in her personal life. On the other hand, Maya's family get ready for her 'mehendi' ceremony. Jhanvi instructs the security guards to not allow Ashwin to enter the hall.

videos.title: Ashwin Fires A Bullet
videos.overview: Arjun and Maya's families gather for the Mehendi ceremony. Ashwin, on the other hand, fixes silencer to his gun and points it at Maya. Jhanvi spots Ashwin in the adjacent apartment. She pushes Maya forward and saves her from getting hurt by the bullet. Vandana learns that Arjun had bribed her astrologer to lie to her about Maya's natal chart.

videos.title: Maya Tattooes Her Name On Arjun
videos.overview: Arjun intrudes into Maya's house. An astrologer informs Vandana that Maya can go to any extent to marry Arjun. On the other hand, Arjun spots his name tattooed on Maya's hand. Later, Maya tattooes her name on Arjun's chest. Arjun returns home and meets his mother. Vandana gets shocked to see Maya's name tattooed on Arjun's chest.

videos.title: Arjun's Bachelor's Party
videos.overview: Vandana requests Saanjh to stop Arjun and Maya's wedding. Ayan and his friends arrange bachelor's party for Arjun. Ayan forces Arjun to drink alcohol. Arjun advises Ayan to lure and marry a rich girl, the way he has attracted Maya. Ayan asks Arjun if he really loves Maya.

videos.title: Arjun Promises Maya
videos.overview: Arjun meets Maya in front of a small temple. He promises Maya to that he would fulfil all her wishes. Ashwin plans to ruin Maya's wedding. Jhanvi vows to prevent Ashwin from causing any harm to Maya. Later, Arjun informs Vandana that Maya has demanded seven promises from him. Saanjh decides to participate in Arjun’s wedding.

videos.title: Vandana Asks Saanjh To Stop Arjun's Wedding
videos.overview: Arjun’s family participate in his wedding procession as they walk towards the wedding venue. Ashwin kidnaps Vandana and tells her that his daughter Maya is mentally ill. He requests Vandana to not allow Arjun to marry Maya. Later, Vandana calls Saanjh and asks her to stop Arjun and Maya’s wedding.

videos.title: Vandana Stops Arjun's Wedding Ceremony
videos.overview: Vandana plans to stop Arjun and Maya’s wedding. She intrudes into their wedding ceremony and asks Arjun to not marry Maya at any cost. She further tells Arjun that Maya is mentally ill. Arjun clears it to his mother that he is determined to marry Maya. Jhanvi comes to Ashwin’s house and points a gun at him.

videos.title: Maya Gets Married To Arjun
videos.overview: Asha tells Sonakshi that she should get married in the near future. Dev gets shocked to see Sonakshi and her daughter Suhana in the school. He meets Sonakshi and asks her to stop following him. Sonakshi’s friend Jatin meets her in her office. Dev and his colleagues plan to organize a party in their office.

videos.title: Police Interrogate Arjun
videos.overview: The police come to Arjun’s wedding hall. They interrogate Arjun about Ashwin’s death. A policeman reminds Arjun that he was not on good terms with Ashwin. The police bring Arjun to the police station for further probing. Arjun clears it to the police that he has not killed Ashwin. Saanjh shows Ashwin’s post-mortem report to the police. She tells the police that Ashwin has died due to heart attack.

videos.title: Maya Refuses To Marry Arjun
videos.overview: Maya tells Arjun that she does not wish to put his life in risk. She further tells Arjun that she will not marry him. Arjun clears it to Maya that he is determined to marry her. Arjun and his family come to Maya’s house for Ashwin’s ‘chautha’. A police tells his constable that Ashwin has died under mysterious circumstances.

videos.title: Arjun Brings Maya To His House
videos.overview: Maya's mother asks Maya to stay along with Arjun in his house. Vandana tells Saanjh that Arjun should not have married Maya at any cost. Vandana tells Ayan that Maya comes from a dysfunctional family. Arjun yells at his mother for disrespecting Maya. Arjun brings Maya to his house.

videos.title: Maya Apologizes To Vandana
videos.overview: Saanjh and Ayan welcome Maya to Arjun's house. Maya pushes a bowl of rice with one of her feet and enters the house. A small piece of glass hurts Maya's leg. Arjun brings Maya to his room. Later, Maya meets Vandana and tells her she wishes to win her heart.

videos.title: Janhavi Spots Ashwin In Her House
videos.overview: Janhavi calls Maya and tells her that Ashwin has returned home. Maya and Arjun rush to Janhavi's house. Baffled Janhavi tells Maya that she has not seen Ashwin in her bungalow. A doctor tells Arjun that Maya's mother is shocked due to Ashwin's sudden death. Vandana tells Saanjh that she is concerned for Arjun's future.

videos.title: Saanjh Gifts Honeymoon Tickets To Arjun and Maya
videos.overview: Arjun and Maya come to Vandana's house. Saanjh gifts honeymoon tickets to the newly married couple. Vandana tells Saanjh that she should not have forced Arjun and Maya to go abroad for honeymoon. Arjun and Maya get ready to go to Switzerland for their honeymoon. A policeman comes to Janhavi's house. He tells Arjun and Maya that they can not leave the city until the investigation of Ashwin's death is completed.

videos.title: Police Arrest Arjun, Maya and Janhavi
videos.overview: A policeman informs Saanjh that Ashwin has been murdered. He presents Ashwin's post-mortem report to Saanjh. The police arrest Arjun, Maya and Janhavi and bring them to the police station. The police interrogate them separately and force them to confess the crime. Arjun learns that Ashwin was murdered by injecting an injection in his body.

videos.title: Vandana Blames Maya For Ashwin's Murder
videos.overview: A policeman tells Arjun that he would soon find out Ashwin's murderer. Saanjh requests Vandana to not interfere in Arjun and Maya's marriage. Vandana informs Saanjh that she had asked the police to reinvestigate the case of Ashwin's murder. Maya learns that Vandana suspects her to be Ashwin's murderer.

videos.title: The Police Blame Janhavi For Ashwin's Death
videos.overview: Vandana angrily throws one of Maya's dresses on the floor. She refuses to put the dress in the washing machine. Arjun tells Maya that Janhavi has killed Ashwin. Arjun and Maya come to a police station to meet Janhavi. The police informs them that they have found Janhavi's gun in Ashwin's house.

videos.title: Janhavi Decides To Commit Suicide
videos.overview: Maya requests the police to not put Janhavi behind bars. Saanjh informs the police that they can not arrest Janhavi in the evening. The police allow Janhavi to go back to her house. Janhavi pushes Maya out of her car and moves towards her house. Janhavi plans to commit suicide.

videos.title: Arjun and Maya Stop Janhavi From Committing Suicide
videos.overview: Janhavi tells Arjun that she has spotted Ashwin in her house. Arjun and Maya remind Janhavi that Ashwin is not alive. A doctor tells Arjun that Janhavi is mentally unstable and needs counselling. Saanjh tells her brother that she loves Arjun. The doctor explains Arjun a method to treat Janhavi.

videos.title: Police Come To Maya's House To Arrest Janhavi
videos.overview: Arjun tells Saanjh that Janhavi might have killed Ashwin. He requests Saanjh to save Janhavi from police inquiry. The police come to Maya's house to arrest Janhavi. Saanjh clears it to the police that they can not arrest Maya's mother. She presents Janhavi's anticipatory bail letter to the police. Later, Saanjh interrogates Maya about Janhavi's involvement in Ashwin's murder.

videos.title: Vandana Slaps Maya For Ruining Arjun's Life
videos.overview: Vandana meets Maya in a temple. She slaps Maya and angrily asks her to not cause any harm to her son. Arjun invites one of his friends to Janhavi's house. He tells Janhavi that he can contact Ashwin's spirit with the help of 'Ouija Board'. Later, Janhavi calls Maya and asks her to come to their godown. She tells Maya that she knows the name of Ashwin's murderer.

videos.title: Janhavi Calls Maya To Godown
videos.overview: Janhavi calls Maya and asks her to come to their godown. She informs Maya that she knows Ashwin's murderer. Arjun, Maya and Saanjh rush to the godown. A policeman comes to Saanjh's house and meets her father. Arjun and Maya fail to search Janhavi in the godown. Saanjh tells Arjun that they should file Janhavi's missing complaint in a police station.

videos.title: Police Handcuff Arjun For Ashwin's Murder
videos.overview: Arjun and Maya come to a police station to lodge Janhavi's missing complaint. A police inspector blames Arjun for Ashwin's murder. Ayan informs Vandana that the police will soon arrest Arjun for killing Ashwin. Vandana comes to the police station and yellls at Maya for ruining Arjun's life. Maya tells the police that she had killed Ashwin.

videos.title: Janhavi Slips Into A State Of Coma
videos.overview: Maya asks police to not arrest Arjun. The police inform Maya that Janhavi has tried to commit suicide. Maya assumes that Janhavi has murdered Ashwin. Maya and Arjun rush to a hospital to see Janhavi. A doctor tells Maya that her mother is in a coma and may not regain consciousness.

videos.title: Maya Returns Her Golden Chain To Vandana
videos.overview: Maya instructs her servants to look after her ailing mother. Arjun and Maya come to Vandana's house. Arjun calls Maya on the terrace of the house. Maya returns a golden chain to Vandana. She clears it to Vandana that she will continue to stay along with Arjun in the future.

videos.title: Arjun Plans To Bring Janahvi To His House
videos.overview: Maya comes to Janhavi's house. She punishes a nurse for not looking after her mother. Arjun tells Maya that they should take Janhavi to his house. Arjun and Maya come to Vandana's house. Vandana clears it to Arjun that she will not allow him to bring Janhavi to her house at any cost.

videos.title: Arjun And Maya Move Out Of Janhavi's House
videos.overview: Arjun tells Vadana that he does not wish to stay along with her. Saanjh requests Arjun to not walk out of Vandana's house. Arjun and Maya come to Janhavi's house. Arjun tells Maya that he always wanted to stay in a big mansion like hers. Ayan tells Vandana that she should not have allowed Arjun to leave her house.

videos.title: Vandana Refuses To Forgive Maya
videos.overview: Saanjh tells Arjun that she has decided to resign from Maya's company. Vikram praise Arjun for his progress in the company. Maya requests Saanjh to not leave her organization. Maya and Saanjh come to Vandana's house. Maya apologizes to Vandana for her past mistakes. Vandana clears it to Maya that she will not forgive her at any cost.

videos.title: Arjun Admits Maya To Hospital
videos.overview: Arjun tells Ayan that he is not going to stay in Vandana's house in the future. Maya falls unconscious in front of Vandana's house. Arjun and Saanjh admit Maya to a hospital. A doctor informs Arjun that Maya is pregnant. Later. Saanjh excitedly informs the news to Vandana.

videos.title: Arjun Secretly Meets Saanjh
videos.overview: Ayan meets with a minor accident. Later, Ayan tells Saanjh that Arjun should not have misbehaved with Vandana. Arjun offers alcoholic beverage to Maya. However, Maya refuses to drink it. Arjun secretly meets Saanjh in a restaurant. He consumes alcohol despite Saanjh's pleading to him to refrain from the drink.

videos.title: Maya Disallows Vandana From Meeting Her Son
videos.overview: Maya gets upset to see Arjun drunk. Arjun tells Saanjh that he loves her a lot. Arjun returns home and meets Maya. Maya tells Arjun that he should not have broken her trust. Arjun apologizes to Maya for drinking alcohol. Next day, Vandana and Ayan comes to Maya's house. Maya tells them that Arjun doesn't wish to meet them.

videos.title: Arjun Saves Saanjh From Fire
videos.overview: Maya greets Arjun as he enters her house. Vandana requests Ayan to meet Arjun on the day of 'Holi'. Arjun gets shocked to learn that many of his employees are resigning from his company. On the eve of Holi, Vandana and her family gather to celebrate Holika. Saanjh's dress catches fire as she stands near a bonfire. Arjun saves Saanjh from the fire.

videos.title: Arjun Plays Holi With Saanjh
videos.overview: Arjun and his friends gather to celebrate Holi. Saanjh applies color on Arjun's face. Maya gets upset seeing Arjun and Saanjh playing holi with each other. Maya tells Suman that Saanjh's friendship with Arjun may not go down well with their friends. Suman brings Saanjh back to her house.

videos.title: Maya Loses Her Child
videos.overview: Saanjh angrily asks Maya to not ruin her friendship with Arjun. Saanjh plans to reveal Maya's secret to Arjun. Maya falls on her stomach as soon as Saanjh holds one of her hands. Arjun rushes towards Maya but soon he learns that Maya has lost her baby. Arjun breaks his friendship with Saanjh.

videos.title: Maya And Arjun's Love Turns Into Revenge
videos.overview: After three years of unusual married life, Arjun and Maya's relationship has turned toxic. Maya panics when she finds Arjun missing from his room. She soon learns that Arjun wishes to give her a surprise. Saanjh meets Ayan in an airport. Ayan informs Saanjh that he is planning to get married. Arjun anxiously tells Maya that he doesn't want to stay with her anymore.

videos.title: Saanjh Plans To Move On With Her Life
videos.overview: Arjun angrily tells Maya that he hates her a lot. On the other hand, Saanjh meets her family and gives them several gifts. Vandana advises Saanjh to move on with her life. Saanjh informs her family that she has a boyfriend. Maya tells her mother that she will not allow Arjun to walk out of her life.

videos.title: Arjun Plans To Divorce Maya
videos.overview: Maya tells Arjun that she has decided to celebrate their wedding anniversary. While having breakfast, Arjun tells Maya that he wants to divorce her. Saanjh meets Maya in a jewelry shop. Saanjh wishes Maya for her wedding anniversary. Maya invites her friends to her house for the anniversary celebration.

videos.title: Arjun Spoils Maya's Party
videos.overview: Maya gifts a necklace to Arjun on the occasion of their marriage anniversary. Arjun angrily throws the necklace on the floor. He notices a microphone hidden in the necklace. Arjun yells at Maya for her misbehaviour. On the other hand, Ayan introduces his girlfriend to his family.

videos.title: Arjun And Maya Hold A Press Conference
videos.overview: Saanjh finds out that Arjun and Maya are not on good terms with each other. Saanjh comes to Vandana's house. Arjun and Maya hold a press conference. In front of media, Arjun gives credit of his success to Maya and Janhavi. Maya tells the media that Arjun loves her unconditionally.

videos.title: Saanjh Introduces Samay To Arjun
videos.overview: Maya tells the media that she is pregnant. Vandana tells Saanjh that she was not responsible for Maya's miscarriage in the past. Saanjh and Samay come to a pub for a party. Ayan and Saanjh get shocked to see Arjun in the pub. Saanjh introduces Samay to Arjun.

videos.title: Arjun Plans To Move Out Of Maya's House
videos.overview: Saanjh tells Arjun that she had informed Maya about Ayan's proposed engagement. Arjun gets shocked to see Maya in a pub. Arjun brings Maya back to their house. He offers a bowl of soup to Janhavi. Arjun asks Maya as to why she didn't inform him about Ayan's engagement.

videos.title: Arjun Puts A Knife On His Neck
videos.overview: Arjun saves Maya from falling off the balcony of her apartment. Saanjh tells her family that she is concerned for Arjun's future. Vandana advises Saanjh to move on with life. On the other hand, Maya invites Arjun for breakfast. Arjun puts knife against his neck.

videos.title: Arjun Plans To Go Out Of Town
videos.overview: Arjun tells Maya that he is planning to go out of town along with his staff. Arjun comes to his office and meets his team. Maya enters Arjun's cabin and disturbs him in his work. Maya finds a bouquet of flowers on her desk. She assumes that Arjun has given her the bouquet.

videos.title: Samay Meets Maya
videos.overview: Maya finds a fish pond in front of her cabin. She gets shocked to see Samay' in her office. Samay'a tells Maya that he missed her a lot. Saanjh asks Arjun if he is on good terms with Maya. Arjun clears it to Saanjh that he will continue to stay with Maya in the future.

videos.title: Ayan And Arjun Mend Their Relationship
videos.overview: Maya asks Samay to meet her in a cafe. Arjun gets shocked to see Ayan and Saanjh in a restaurant. Ayan tells Saanjh that he doesn't wish to keep any relationship with Arjun. Maya puts Samay in her car and brings him to an isolated place. Saanjh advises Ayan and Arjun to mend their broken relationship.

videos.title: Arjun Reunites With His Family
videos.overview: Maya asks Samay' to not interfere in her personal life. Arjun comes to Ayan's house to meet Vandana. Vandana tells Arjun that he should not have broken his relationship with his family. Arjun apologizes to Vandana for his past mistakes. He further tells Vandana that Maya is going to London.

videos.title: Maya Stabs An Injection On Arjun's Neck
videos.overview: Arjun tells Ayan that Maya is extremely possessive about him. Vandana advises Arjun to stay away from alcohol. Arjun gets shocked to see Maya in an ambulance. Arjun boards the ambulance as it heads towards a hospital. Maya stabs an injection on Arjun's neck. She brings Arjun to her house.

videos.title: Ayan Molests Maya
videos.overview: Maya locks Arjun in a room. Ayan intrudes into Maya's house to teach her a lesson. He tells Maya that he wants to meet Arjun. Maya replies Ayan that Arjun is not home. Ayan finds Arjun in a room. He approaches towards Maya and molests her. The police arrest Ayan for his crime.

videos.title: Police Arrest Ayan
videos.overview: Maya tells Arjun that his brother molested her in her house. The police put Ayan behind bars for molesting Maya. Saanjh and Vandana come to the police station to meet Ayan. Ayan tells Saanjh that he has not molested Maya. Vandana angrily asks Arjun to not blame her son for the alleged crime.

videos.title: Arjun Decides To Take Legal Action Against Ayan
videos.overview: Ayan clears it to Saanjh that he has not molested Arjun's wife. Arjun decides to take legal action against Ayan for molesting Maya. Saanjh tells Samay' that she will not allow Maya to win the court case. Arjun convinces Maya to let doctors do her medical tests. Saanjh comes to the Court to lead Ayan's case against Maya.

videos.title: Saanjh Questions Arjun About His Relationship With Maya
videos.overview: Saanjh asks Arjun as to where he was when his wife was being molested by Ayan. Arjun replies Saanjh that he was asleep during the incident. Saanjh tells the Judge that Maya had spread false rumours about her pregnancy. She further states that Maya was not molested by Ayan.

videos.title: Saanjh Exposes Maya In Court
videos.overview: Saanjh instructs Maya to stand in the witness-box. She asks Maya as to why she cancelled her London trip. Maya replies Saanjh that she cancelled the trip as she was concerned about Arjun's health. Saanjh tells the Judge that Maya had locked Arjun in her room at the time of her alleged molestation by Ayan.

videos.title: Court Finds Ayan Guilty Of Molesting Maya
videos.overview: Maya shows her injury marks to the Judge. She tells the Judge that she is a victim and not a criminal. Maya's lawyer calls Samay' to the witness box. Samay' tells the Court that he had stopped Ayan from molesting Maya. The Judge finds Ayan guilty in the molestation case.

videos.title: Judge Sentences Ayan To Jail
videos.overview: The Judge sentences Ayan to jail for attempting to rape Maya. A few women try to blacken Saanjh's face. Maya stops the women from attacking Saanjh. Samay tells Saanjh that he should not have come to the Court. Saanjh's mother advises her to not lose her self respect. She advises her to marry Samay.

videos.title: Vandana Attacks Maya
videos.overview: Saanjh asks Samay as to why he hide his secrets from her. Samay assumes that Saanjh is aware of his relationship with Maya. On the other hand, Vandana requests Arjun to forgive Ayan for his mistake. Arjun refuses to help his mother. Vandana attacks Maya with a knife.

videos.title: Arjun Admits Vandana To A Hospital
videos.overview: Arjun stops Vandana from attacking Maya. Vandana falls unconscious on the road. Arjun admits Vandana to a hospital. Saanjh and her mother come to the hospital to see Vandana. Saanjh's mother blames Maya for Vandana's condition. Later, a doctor tells Arjun that he can take Vandana back to his house. Arjun requests Saanjh to look after Vandana.

videos.title: Maya Brings Vandana To Her House
videos.overview: Arjun requests Saanjh to look after his mother. Vandana tells Saanjh that she doesn't wish to go to Maya's house. Saanjh replies Vandana that she can not help her anymore. Maya brings Vandana to her house. Saanjh asks Vandana to not reveal their secret plan to anyone.

videos.title: Maya Tortures Vandana
videos.overview: Maya tells Arjun that she will not take him away from his family. Vandana learns that Maya has installed many CCTV cameras in her house. Maya tells Vandana that she can track all her moves through the cameras. Maya forces Vandana to not keep her mobile phone beside her bed. Saanjh tries to contact Vandana on her phone, but fails to reach her.

videos.title: Vandana Apologizes To Maya
videos.overview: Saanjh tells Samay' that she would soon release Ayan from jail. Samay' tries to call Maya but fails to reach her. Vandana informs Saanjh that Maya is observing her every move through cameras. Vandana apologizes to Maya for her past mistakes. Arjun asks Vandana to not interfere in his personal life.

videos.title: Maya Drops Vandana's Phone In Water
videos.overview: Saanjh tries to call Vandana but fails to reach her. Maya drops Vandana's phone in a bucket filled with water. Later, Maya gifts a new mobile phone to Vandana. While going to office, Maya forces Vananda to talk to Janhavi. In Maya's absence, Vandana goes to her room.

videos.title: Maya Injures Vandana's Hand
videos.overview: Vandana secretly enters Maya's room. She plans to open Maya's cupboard. Maya comes to her house and starts searching for Vandana. Maya spots Vandana in her room. She traps one of Vandana's hands between two doors. Vandana starts yelling and requests Maya to open the doors. Later, Saanjh comes to Maya's house. She gets shocked to see Vandana's bleeding hand.

videos.title: Saanjh Informs Arjun About Maya's Atrocities
videos.overview: Maya reminds Vandana that she had deliberately injured her hand in the past. Vandana calls Saanjh and asks her to stay away from Maya's house. Samay' calls Maya and tells her that he wishes to meet her. On the other hand, Saanjh informs Arjun that Maya has broken one of Vandana's hands.

videos.title: Maya Advises Samay To Marry Saanjh
videos.overview: Saanjh tells Arjun that Maya has injured Vandana's hand. Samay meets Maya and tell her that he loves her a lot. Maya replies Samay that she is happily married to Arjun. Samay reminds Maya that he had helped her win legal case against Ayan. Maya advises Samay to marry Saanjh.

videos.title: Maya Whips Herself With A Belt
videos.overview: Arjun spots injury marks on one of Vandana's hands. He apologizes to Vandana for his past mistakes. He plans to beat Maya for attacking his mother. He locks Maya in a room. Maya whips herself with a belt. Arjun stops Maya from attacking herself. Maya tells Arjun that she had not injured Vandana's hand.

videos.title: Samay Proposes Saanjh For Marriage
videos.overview: Maya tells Vandana that she loves Arjun a lot. Arjun meets Vandana and tells her that Maya has mental illness. He tells Vandana that they must look after Maya. Vandana replies Arjun that he has made a mistake by marrying Maya. On the other hand, Samay proposes Saanjh for marriage.

videos.title: Vandana Dumps Trash On Saanjh's Head
videos.overview: Maya apologizes to Vandana for her past mistakes. Saanjh tells her mother that she wishes to invite Vandana for her engagement ceremony. Samay and Saanjh come to Maya's house. Vandana angrily dumps trash on Saanjh's head. Saanjh collects the trash in a bag and goes back to her house.

videos.title: Samay Cuts His Own Finger
videos.overview: Maya finds out that Vandana had sent a secret message to Saanjh. Vandana tells Maya that she should not have insulted Saanjh. She further tells Maya that she wishes to go to Saanjh's house. Maya advises Samay to get engaged to Saanjh. Samay anxiously cuts one of his fingers.

videos.title: Vandana Plans To Give A Secret Gift To Saanjh
videos.overview: Vandana tells Maya that she is going to attend Saanjh's engagement ceremony. Saanjh's mother tells her that she is excited as her daughter is getting married. Samay' meets Maya and tells her that he doesn't wish to marry Saanjh. Maya clears it to Samay' that she can not leave Arjun to marry him.

videos.title: Saanjh And Samay' Exchange Rings
videos.overview: Saanjh finds Vandana's letter in her gift box. She reads out the letter which mentions a few digits of a mobile number. Saanjh calls Vandana and asks her to find a proof against Maya in her room. Vandana plans to enter the room where Maya monitors her CCTV footages. Saanjh and Samay exchange rings at their engagement ceremony.

videos.title: Saanjh Plans To Expose Samay
videos.overview: Saanjh secretly steals Maya's mobile phone. Vandana tries to scan CCTV footages in Maya's house. Janhavi signs to Vandana that Maya was not molested by Ayan. Vandana learns that Maya is suffering from depression. Saanjh finds out that Maya is secretly talking to Samay over mobile phone.

videos.title: Saanjh Questions Samay' On His Relationship With Maya
videos.overview: Maya returns home from Saanjh's engagement ceremony. She learns that Vandana had tried to contact Saanjh in her absence. Saanjh confronts Samay on his relationship with Maya. Maya asks Vandana as to why she tries to mend her relationship with Saanjh. Samay and Saanjh come to Maya's house.

videos.title: Saanjh Fails To Expose Maya's Secret
videos.overview: Saanjh asks Maya if she has secret relationship with Samay'. Maya tells Saanjh that she worships her friendship with Samay'. Maya requests Saanjh to marry Samay'. Arjun angrily asks Saanjh to not interfere in Maya's personal life. Later, Saanjh requests Samay' to not meet Maya in the future.

videos.title: Maya threatens Vandana With Knife
videos.overview: Maya notices Ashwin's photo in Janhavi's room. Maya reminds Janhavi that she had killed Ashwin on the day of her wedding. Maya enters Vandana's room. She puts Vandana to sleep. Next morning, Vandana informs Arjun that Maya had threatened her with a knife. Vandana calls Saanjh and asks her to come to Arjun's house.

videos.title: Saanjh Intrudes Into Maya's House
videos.overview: Saanjh comes to Arjun's house in the guise of a courier delivery girl. Vandana welcomes her to the house. Arjun and Maya too enter the house. Vandana asks Saanjh to hide behind a bush. Saanjh enters Janhavi's room to find a proof against Maya. Saanjh finds a pen drive in the room.

videos.title: Maya Finds Saanjh In Her House
videos.overview: Vandana and Saanjh scan CCTV footages of Maya's house. They learn that Ayan had not molested Maya. Later, Maya finds out that her CCTV cameras are not working properly. Samay informs Maya that Saanjh is hiding in her house. Saanjh appears before Maya. Maya shoots Saanjh with her gun.

videos.title: Arjun Admits Maya In Hospital
videos.overview: Saanjh tells Maya that she has forwarded the content of her pen drive to Samay' and her father. Maya aims a gun towards Saanjh and Vandana. Maya falls unconscious as soon as Arjun and Samay' enter her room. Arjun admits Maya in a hospital. A doctor tells Arjun that Maya is pregnant.

videos.title: Arjun Informs Saanjh About Maya's Pregnancy
videos.overview: Saanjh enters Maya's hospital room. She tells Maya that she will soon put her behind bars as she has got proofs against her. Arjun informs Saanjh that his wife Maya is pregnant. He angrily asks Saanjh to not interfere in his life. He also clears it to Saanjh that he doesn't love her.

videos.title: Samay Kills Saanjh's Father
videos.overview: Saanjh informs her father that she has sent an important email to him. Samay throws Prem on an electricity box. Prem falls on the ground when he gets electric shock. On the other hand, Maya informs Janhavi that she is pregnant. Arjun tells Maya that Prem has passed away.

videos.title: Arjun Comforts Saanjh As Prem Passes Away
videos.overview: Arjun informs Maya and Janhavi that Prem has passed away. He goes to Saanjh's house to comfort her family. Samay enters anxiously and tells Maya that she has forced him to murder Prem. Maya clears it to Samay that she is not responsible for Prem's murder.

videos.title: Saanjh Lights Her Fathers Pyre
videos.overview: Arjun asks Saanjh to light her father's pyre. Later, Maya welcomes Arjun as he returns home. Arjun tells Maya that he is upset as Saanjh has lost her father. Arjun visits Saanjh's house to comfort her. Saanjh tells Arjun that she is missing her father a lot.

videos.title: Maya Throws Samay Out Of Her House

videos.title: Arjun Confronts Maya
videos.overview: Arjun has no other choice but to meet Maya in an attempt to persuade her to stop her evil intentions. But, Maya refuses to listen to Arjun. Later, Arjun and Saanjh try to find solace in each others company and forget about Maya. Meanwhile, Maya is busy planning her next move in order to harm Saanjh.

videos.title: The Sangeet Ceremony
videos.overview: Arjun and Ayan are left frustrated when the security agencies demand huge sums for offering their services. Then, Ayan tells Arjun that he will arrange a metal detector from his friend. Meanwhile, Arjun asks Ayan and Shubh to bring in all their friends to provide security for the ceremony. On the other hand, Maya has designed another plan to disrupt the ceremony. Will Maya be able to make her plan work? Find out!

videos.title: Saanjh Is Stabbed
videos.overview: Arjun and Saanjh forget about Maya and enjoy their wedding forgetting the ominous signs. The hitman sent by Maya is planning to kill Saanjh. Meanwhile, Maya is rejoicing in anticipation of Saanjh's death. Then, tragedy strikes Arjun and Saanjh as the bride to be is stabbed.

videos.title: Will Maya Be Hanged?
videos.overview: When Saanjh locks herself inside the room, Arjun enters through the window and persuades her. He helps Saanjh get ready for their wedding. Meanwhile, the jailer informs Maya that the time for her hanging is minutes away. Maya asks that jailer that she wants to call Lalvani as her last wish. What final surprises does Maya have up her sleeves and will she be hanged? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Arjun Weds Saanjh
videos.overview: Arjun and Saanjh learn that Maya's death sentence has been pardoned. Realising she and Arjun are not safe with Maya still alive, Saanjh decides to call off the wedding. But, Arjun wants to go ahead with the marriage and ties the knot with Saanjh. Maya learns from her informer that Arjun and Saanjh are now married. Even after completing the wedding formalities, the fear of Maya's arrival is still lurking behind the corner for Saanjh.

videos.title: Maya's End Or A New Beginning?
videos.overview: After witnessing an unpleasant event, Saanjh decides to leave the house. But, Arjun calms her down and assures her of safety. Meanwhile, in the prison, the jailer makes Maya watch Arjun and Saanjh's wedding. Then, Maya's mother meets the jailer and bribes her to kill Maya. The jailer hatches a plan to kill Maya later that night. Is this the end of Maya? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Will Arjun Kill Maya?
videos.overview: The jailer's plan to kill Maya backfires on her as Maya turns the tables on her and kills her. After conducting an inquiry, Maya is sent to solitary confinement. Meanwhile, Saanjh learns about this and suffers a brain stroke. Arjun having had enough of Maya's ominous presence in his life, deices to end her life. Will Arjun pull the trigger and kill Maya? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Five Years Later
videos.overview: Five years have passed since Arjun last saw Maya. He returns home and finds something eerie in the house. He pulls out a gun in a bid to neutralise the threat. However, Saanjh arrives with her family and friends and congratulates Arjun on his latest achievements. Arjun is ecstatic to see his daughter, Arohi and shares the happiness with his family. But, Maya's last words that she will return one day, still haunt Arjun.

videos.title: Maya's New Ploy
videos.overview: Arjun is worried that Maya might arrive into their lives at any moment and their happiness will be at stake once she arrives. Meanwhile, Maya is plotting her next move to exact revenge on Saanjh. At Arjun's residence, a journalist makes the mistake of asking him about Maya. Arjun loses his cool and shouts at the journalist and asks her leave. Arohi overhears Maya's name and asks Arjun about her.

videos.title: Maya's Death
videos.overview: Tulsi meets Maya for the last time before leaving. Maya kills Tulsi in a bid to escape. Then, Maya falls unconscious as per her plan. The doctor arrives at the scene and declares Maya dead. After Maya is shifted to the morgue, she wakes up, ready to escape and exact revenge on Saanjh.

videos.title: Maya Returns
videos.overview: Maya sets fire to the morgue to wipe out any evidence that could prove that she is still alive. The hospital staff believe that Maya's dead body was charred in the accident. Later, Maya escapes and finds Arjun's house. She stands outside his house and sees him with Saanjh and Arohi. Maya is heartbroken and decides to exact revenge on Saanjh using Arohi.

videos.title: Maya Meets Arohi
videos.overview: Lalwani finds Maya before Arjun's bodyguards do and helps her escape. The next day, Maya arrives at Arohi's school and creates a distraction to gain Arohi's trust. Maya pretends to be one of the staff and starts working in the school. Meanwhile, Saanjh suspects that something bad is about to happen.

videos.title: Arohi's New Friend
videos.overview: Maya meets Arohi and tries to befriend her. But, before she can do so, Arjun and Saanjh arrive at the school. Maya gets terrified and wears a mask to hide her identity. Arjun bumps into Maya but does not recognize her. Later, Saanjh arrives at a graveyard to meet a stranger.

videos.title: Arjun's Nightmare
videos.overview: Arjun wakes up from a nightmare, in which he saw Saanjh getting killed. Arjun believes that someone has entered the property and orders the guards to conduct a search. Meanwhile, at school, Aarohi sees Maya coming out of the store room. She questions Maya about the need to access the store room, which is out of bounds for the staff. Later, Lalwani arrives at Arjun's factory and mixes a substance in the solution.

videos.title: Aarohi is Missing
videos.overview: Lalwani does his job and escapes before Arjun can catch hold of him. Aarohi bumps into Maya and finds her secretive. Jhanvi arrives at the school but fails to find Aarohi. Meanwhile, Arjun suspects something to be wrong and orders all the stocks to be recalled. But, the damage has been done as children who have eaten the chocolates being to fall sick.

videos.title: Arjun's Death Trap
videos.overview: Arjun finds an old tape recorder. When he plays it, he discovers Maya's favourite song and reaises that she has escaped from the morgue. He goes to Maya's psychiatrist to enquire about Maya. Meanwhile Maya tries to get close to Arohi. Later, Arjun decides to make a plan to take his revenge on Maya.

videos.title: Maya's Grand Entry
videos.overview: Arjun gets ready to kill Maya and loads his gun with bullets. Meanwhile, Saanjh suspects that Arjun is hiding something from her. Arjun reaches the venue for the garba night. While he is searching for Maya, she comes and pats his back. Will Arjun manage to accomplish what he has come for? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Maya Takes Her Revenge
videos.overview: Arjun points a gun at Maya and plans to shoot her. But she tells him that Saanjh's life is in danger. Meanwhile, Saanjh narrowly escapes being hit by a truck while coming to the garba venue. Later, Arjun and Saanjh reach Aarohi's school and find her lying unconscious. They find out that she has been poisoned. Maya disguises herself as a hospital nurse and comes to take her revenge. Will she succeed? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Saanjh Is Separated From Aarohi
videos.overview: Maya arrives at the hospital, while Aarohi is being operated upon. She makes sure Aarohi lives and reveals that her intention was never to harm Aarohi. She does want to take revenge but not at the cost of Aarohi's life. After Aarohi is discharged from the hospital, Ayaan decides to take Aarohi along with him for her own safety.

videos.title: Maya's New Plan
videos.overview: Saanjh breaks down remembering Aarohi. Meanwhile, Maya tells Lalwani that she merely used Aarohi to hurt Arjun. Then, Arjun is informed by his bodyguards about Maya's whereabouts. But, when they reach the spot, Maya is no where to be found. Later, Saanjh is diagnosed with depression. Wanting to help Saanjh, Arjun assures Saanjh that Maya will never be able to take away their happiness.

videos.title: The Surrogate Mother
videos.overview: Maya calls up Arjun and lets him know that he cannot stop her from meeting him. Later, Arjun and Saanjh arrive at the fertility centre and meet the woman who has been chosen as the surrogate mother for their child. When she is taken inside the operation theatre, Maya plays out her plan and gives money to the woman. Will Arjun and Saanjh find out Maya's plan before its too late? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Maya Meets Arjun
videos.overview: On his way to the hospital, Arjun encounters the surrogate woman who was supposed to carry Saanjh's child. Realising that something is wrong, he rushes to the hospital and notices Maya, who informs him that now she is the surrogate mother. Maya puts forth a condition before Arjun and asks him to take her home. Arjun gets furious at this and tries to choke Maya.

videos.title: Maya Arrives In Arjun's House
videos.overview: Maya asks Saanjh to take the decision: to either take her home or put her behind bars. Maya then arrives at Arjun's house. Maya's mother is shocked to see her. They are informed that Maya is the surrogate mother to Arjun and Saanjh's child.

videos.title: Maya Returns
videos.overview: Everyone gets worried after seeing Maya back in the house. Arjun arrives at the police station to file a complaint against Maya but thinks of Sanjh and stops. Meanwhile, Maya makes Sanjh feel guilty for being unable to be a mother. How Arjun and Sanjh face problem after allowing Maya live in their house? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: The Beginning of Maya's Revenge
videos.overview: Maya's obsession blurs into a vengeful quest to destroy Saanjh's life. At midnight, Maya enters her mother's room. Before she can carry out her evil pursuits, her mother turns around, which saves her life. Maya's mother then warns Arjun about the storm that is about to hit their lives.

videos.title: Maya's New Strategy
videos.overview: Saanjh's mother sees her daughter taking care of Maya. She expresses her displeasure to Saanjh, who informs that Maya is the surrogate to her child. Maya overhears this conversation. After they leave the kitchen, Maya mixes a substance in a glass of milk. What is Maya upto this time? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Seed of Suspicion
videos.overview: Maya claims that Suman tried to kill her. While Suman tries to prove her innocence, Maya succeeds in plating the seed of suspicion in Saanjh's mind but fails to do the same with Arjun. Maya can't fathom the thought that Arjun does not trust her anymore.

videos.title: Saanjh's Prank On Arjun
videos.overview: Maya's words haunt Arjun and he wakes up from a nightmare. He searches for the Saanjh in the house but does not find her. Everyone suspects that Maya has done something to Saanjh. But, to Arjun's relief, he finds Saanjh outside. This turns out to be a prank played on Arjun. Maya and Arjun head to the clinic to determine if Maya is pregnant. Watch and find out what happens next.

videos.title: Maya's Fast
videos.overview: Saanjh is worried that Maya and Arjun are nowhere to be found. She is unaware that they are at the clinic to determine whether Maya is pregnant. Maya is relived to know that she is pregnant but Arjun is not happy about it. Then, Maya informs Saanjh that she is observing fast for Arjun.

videos.title: Saanjh's Concern
videos.overview: Maya informs Saanjh that she wants to apply Mehendi. Arjun is still thinking about Maya's decision to keep fast for him. When Maya sees Arjun with Saanjh, she gets distressed. Will Arjun feed Maya and end her fast? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Maya's Rage
videos.overview: Arjun makes it clear to Maya that he rejects having loved her. Maya is furious that Arjun thinks about her this way. In anger, Maya takes the car and drives away, forcing Saanjh to follow her. Arjun now has to stop Maya before she hurts herself and his child.

videos.title: Maya's Anger
videos.overview: Arjun is informed by the doctor that he has to take special care of Maya as any emotional trauma can have adverse effects on the pregnancy. Later, Arjun shouts at Saanjh for not taking care of Maya. Saanjh breaks down but knows that Arjun is taking care of Maya as she is pregnant with her child.

videos.title: When Death Comes Knocking
videos.overview: Maya's mother claims that Maya tried to kill her, which Maya claims to be an allegation. Maya announces that she will leave the house, unable to bear this humiliation. Will Arjun stop Maya from leaving the house? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Maya's Manipulation
videos.overview: At the baby shower, Maya and Arjun arrive at their house. Saanjh is disappointed to see Arjun taking care of Maya. Then, Maya informs Saanjh that she wants Arjun in return for giving her the child. Saanjh slaps Maya. Surprisingly, Arjun slaps Saanjh and informs her that she did a mistake by bringing Maya into the house. Then, Maya goes into labor and is rushed to the hospital.

videos.title: A New Life is Born
videos.overview: The doctor informs Arjun and Saanjh that the delivery has been successful. But, before Arjun and Saanjh can get the time to spend with their daughter, Maya escapes with the newborn. Arjun and Saanjh find Maya and Saanjh decide to speak with her. When Saanjh meets Maya, the latter pulls out a gun on her. Will Arjun save Saanjh at the cost of Maya's life? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Maya Sets Her Crosshairs
videos.overview: Maya saves Rishi from drowning into the ocean. His father is angry at him for being careless, but Rishi is glad to find the love of his life. Later that day, Maya beats Rudra in fencing and invokes the hatred in his heart for her. Guests start arriving for the anniversary party while Maya solidifies her revengeful plan. Stay Tuned!

videos.title: Maya Is Always A Step Ahead
videos.overview: Rishi is busy finding Maya's address, and she already knows about it. Meanwhile, MJ gets to know about the article issue raised in Rudra and Ananya's company. MJ offers to help them, but Rudra refuses and leaves the house. Rishi enters Maya's house and finds her standing with a gun in her hand. Stay Tuned!

videos.title: MJ Senses The Trouble
videos.overview: Maya gets a fire alarm on her phone and rushes back to the house to see that her mother tried to bake her brother's favorite cake, and it got ruined. Meanwhile, MJ finds the rope mark on Rishi's foot and suspects the danger vividly. Next Morning, Rudra sets his mission to sign Maya for their company. Let's see how that goes for him. Stay Tuned!

videos.title: Rishi's First Date With Maya
videos.overview: Rishi's friends are curious to know about his new crush, and to his surprise, he finds Maya waiting outside the college. On the other hand, Rudra is trying to be apologetic to Ananya for his behaviour and breaks the big news. Meanwhile, MJ is still concerned about the welfare of his sons. Stay Tuned!

videos.title: Rudra's Deal With Maya
videos.overview: Rudra gets into Rishi's room and takes his cell away as he was busy with that, even he asks Rishi to be careful with the things he is going through. The next morning, Rudra goes out to meet Maya for a deal and she asks him for a dare. Will Rudra be able to comply with the dare? Watch to know more!

videos.title: Day 2 Of Rudra's Contract
videos.overview: Rudra goes to Vasai to meet Maya for his next task. Meanwhile, MJ had asked Aamir to put a tracker in Rudra's car, and so Aamir follows it to Vasai. But things aren't meant to be that easy when you're competing against Maya. Later, Maya receives a text from Rishi saying he's coming to see her, but Maya has something else in her mind. Stay Tuned!

videos.title: Keeping The Fire Alive
videos.overview: Maya calls Rishi and asks him to meet where she decides to end things with him. Rishi comes back home and talks with his brother. Rudra helps him understand an important relationship lesson. It's late at night, Rudra is talking to Anu when he gets interrupted by Maya about his next task. Stay Tuned!

videos.title: Loyalty, Commitment And Passion
videos.overview: Rudra completes the third and final task of Maya's contract, but little did he know about the actuality behind them. The next morning, Maya breaks the news of her becoming their investor to Rudra, which makes him extremely angry, and he leaves the office. Meanwhile, MJ is trying to deceive Ananya to tell him about their new investor. Stay Tuned!

videos.title: Journey Of The Hurt
videos.overview: MJ is desperate to know the investor of his son's company and gets a hint from Ananya. Rishi comes back disturbed because of his break up and asks for help from the ladies. At the office, Ananya meets Maya and couldn't handle her excitement. She breaks the news to Rudra that MJ has arranged a press conference for Maya. Stay Tuned as Rudra runs down to save Maya.

videos.title: Rudra's Feud With MJ
videos.overview: Rudra saves Maya from being pecked on by the media. On the other hand, MJ comes over to Rudra's office to meet him. Rudra tells him that he isnt invited there and also indicates the fact that their relationship is over. MJ tries to stop him but Rudra is angry and still upset about something from their past. Later Rudra gets MJ thrown out of his office. Stay tuned!
